title: Date Night
subtitle: Offline Mini-Date Pack
positioning: Bonus offline companion to the interactive Date Night WebApp

miniDates.title: Cozy Date
miniDates.moodLine: Slow down. Make a little room for each other.
miniDates.journey: From a small comfort to an imaginary shared haven, then a gentle celebration and a memory to keep.

activities.prompt: Finish this sentence in turn: “A tiny thing that helps me unwind is…” Choose one you could share on an ordinary evening.
activities.reasonSelected: An easy, low-pressure opening grounded in everyday comfort.

activities.prompt: Picture your partner’s ideal end to a busy day: quiet company, a long chat or something to laugh at. Choose their answer before asking them.
activities.compareInstruction: Say your guesses first. Each reveal your choice and the small detail that would make it feel just right.
activities.reasonSelected: Discovers what helps each person settle after a busy day.

activities.prompt: Design an imaginary room made for the two of you. Build it aloud in four rounds: comfort, delight, quiet and one impossible feature; spend a little time exploring each other’s additions.
activities.reasonSelected: A collaborative centerpiece that builds on the idea of comfort.

activities.prompt: Create the smallest possible celebration using only your hands. Teach it to each other and perform your two versions together.
activities.reasonSelected: Shifts from talking to a small, gentle shared gesture.

activities.prompt: Make a spoken postcard from tonight: each choose a moment, a detail and a feeling you would put on it. Share your versions with each other and end with one line you would keep.
activities.reasonSelected: Collects details from this particular date into an intentional ending.

miniDates.title: Funny Date
miniDates.moodLine: Less serious. More reasons to laugh.
miniDates.journey: Warm up with an everyday story, get wonderfully impractical, try a tiny debate and finish with your own sign-off.

activities.prompt: Give today a made-up episode title. Trade the story behind your titles, including the detail that would make the trailer.
activities.reasonSelected: Turns an ordinary day into a light opening story.

activities.prompt: An imaginary remote can mute hiccups, summon a perfect snack or translate animal thoughts. Which button would your partner press first?
activities.compareInstruction: Reveal your choices together. Explain the first situation in which you would use your button.
activities.reasonSelected: Creates a specific absurd choice with an immediate comparison.

activities.prompt: Invent a useless household gadget together. Give it a name, a ridiculous feature and a sales pitch delivered by both of you.
activities.reasonSelected: Makes something together rather than only answering questions.

activities.prompt: Hold three tiny debates: square pillows versus round pillows, whispering robots versus singing doors, and pockets versus capes. Each gets about a minute to make a case per round; change sides for the last one.
activities.reasonSelected: Adds a performance/rivalry energy shift with harmless subjects.

activities.prompt: Invent a short sign-off for tonight using a detail you each enjoyed. Trade the stories behind your choices, combine them into one phrase and choose a playful or quiet way to say it together to end the date.
activities.reasonSelected: Ends with a shared phrase that belongs to this date.

miniDates.title: Romantic Date
miniDates.moodLine: A little more attention. A little more spark.
miniDates.journey: Notice attraction in small details, discover anticipation, create a scene, guess a tempting destination and finish with an ending you both welcome.

activities.prompt: Trade three tiny details that make you feel drawn to your partner: a look, a habit or a way they do something ordinary. Take turns telling the small story behind each one and leave time to hear what they noticed about you.
activities.reasonSelected: Starts with specific attraction rather than forced vulnerability.

activities.prompt: Predict your partner’s favourite kind of anticipation: a playful clue, a direct invitation or a surprise detail. Think of a tasteful example for your guess.
activities.compareInstruction: Reveal your real preferences. Explain which detail makes anticipation fun for you, then compare your examples.
activities.reasonSelected: Makes anticipation personal without explicit content.

activities.prompt: Build a scene with obvious chemistry and no romantic words. Choose a setting, improvise a short exchange, then change who makes the first move in the scene.
activities.reasonSelected: Creates a short shared scene, adding action and chemistry.

activities.prompt: Describe an imaginary date destination using only five words. Your partner gets three guesses before you reveal it; exchange roles and make the second round a little more tempting.
activities.reasonSelected: A five-word destination guessing game shifts from the chemistry scene to playful discovery without a second delivery performance.

activities.prompt: Choose one small way to end with a little more spark: a warm compliment, a held gaze or an offered hand. Each suggest your preference and choose an ending you both welcome.
activities.reasonSelected: Ends with mutual choice and gentle, optional affection.

miniDates.title: Competitive Date
miniDates.moodLine: Friendly rivalry. No score to settle.
miniDates.journey: Recognize each other’s strengths, test predictions, solve an invented mystery and try a shared memory challenge before choosing another date.

activities.prompt: Choose one everyday talent you admire in each other. Explain where you would recruit your partner to use it on an imaginary two-person team.
activities.reasonSelected: Frames the couple as a team before the playful rivalry.

activities.prompt: In three rounds, predict which your partner would rather master: cooking or storytelling, fixing things or finding things, planning or improvising. Give a reason for each guess.
activities.compareInstruction: Reveal your actual choices one pair at a time. Test one prediction with a tiny demonstration of the skill you picked.
activities.reasonSelected: Tests specific guesses without right/wrong relationship judgments.

activities.prompt: Solve a mystery you invent together: why is there a tiny door behind the sofa? Alternate adding clues, discuss two possible explanations and agree on a final reveal.
activities.reasonSelected: An interactive problem to solve collaboratively, with no scoring.

activities.prompt: Build a sound sequence together: one person makes a sound, the other repeats it and adds one. Keep extending it at an easy pace, then try a second sequence with roles reversed.
activities.reasonSelected: Adds a repeat-and-build challenge with natural turns and no loser.

activities.prompt: Each offer one tiny, no-cost date you could share at home another time. Pick the idea you are both most curious about and end by inviting each other to it.
activities.reasonSelected: Directs the energy toward one mutually chosen next date.
